trace_stages: Original mapped EXE near CALL E8 -> BA9D0 OutRunHudTextProducer_dest, with safe unknown on indirect/unrecognized callsite.

Native synchronous put_sprite_ex/put_sprite_ex2 may enter shared unclassified text helper: stable exact text parent + unchanged queue/VR/overlay scope -> live-root bounded SpriteNode registration with original producer token.
Existing R84 physical Draw command and exact ScreenHud stereo route consume queued token; R33 and R30 native fallback and x64 OpenXR are preserved, not represented as HMD evidence.
subcomponents: Reject unverified original text return RVA and indirect parent calls before constructing direct ScreenHud owner in hooks_uiscaling.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Classified original E8 text and edge/peripheral glyphs carry distinct exact ScreenHud producer through nested native nodes; R84 existing stereo path can retain that identity.

Unverified indirect CALLs, producer or queue mutations, VR toggles, external overlays, protected GOAL/+TIME/rank/lens and world cannot acquire native HUD text ownership; native original fallback remains.
Exact last source/test SHA passes required DX9Ex Active, Domain, HUD Inspector and Full Source Impact workflows; headset Quest3/VDXR runtime remains UNTESTED.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Original mapped caller ranges were only a broad SemanticInfo classifier for BA9D0 text, while native put_sprite callbacks have an independently unclassified shared inner callsite.
diagnosis.root_cause: OutRunHudTextProducer_dest classified caller range without verifying the actual E8 parent, and TagDirectVrSpriteNodes returned on the shared unclassified inner call before the exact text/peripheral outer producer could be carried onto appended live SpriteNodes.
source_trace: Original HUD source E8 -> scoped exact text token while native font producer runs.
Shared put_sprite node append -> bounded stable-root queue proof and original parent source stamp.
R84 physical draw consumes ScreenHud producer via current queue and routes through existing guarded stereo eye path.
alternatives_rejected: No broad ret-5 producer tagging for unknown indirect/FF calls.
No reclassification of +TIME, GOAL, car rank or lens as generic text.
No changes to original game binary, DXVK, FFB/input, SkyGlow or R26_SAFE.
